journeys.J1: Standard claim: patient, connector, decision, verified payment
journeys.J2: Caregiver: consent, versions, withdrawal, grievance, Ombudsman, revised decision
journeys.J3: Household: two policies and a balance claim
journeys.J4: Representative not registered at the payer
journeys.J7: Manual route with mock letters and bank statement
journeys.J9: Flawed and malicious documents, injected chat

V-01: Policy facts are read from an uploaded schedule and wait for the user's confirmation
confirm_policy card; nothing used before approval
V-02: Policy corrections: known fields applied, unknown fields ignored, a bad value refused cleanly
corrected field saved; unknown key dropped; 422, not 500
V-03: Onboarding completes only with a confirmed policy, a role and the patient on the policy
V-04: A file that is not a claim document is rejected and its stored copy deleted
status rejected, path empty, not in pack
V-05: Cross-document checks: name, dates, policy period, bill arithmetic, sum insured
each flaw raises its issue code
V-06: Off-topic and instruction-changing chat gets the fixed reply and changes nothing
V-07: The pack needs explicit approval of its exact content; a later change invalidates it
V-08: Pack PDF and email draft download and are valid files
PDF parses with cover page plus documents; EML has attachments
V-09: Submission through the connector creates exactly one claim at the payer
one claim per client reference; button not offered twice
V-10: An accepted submission whose answer was lost is reconciled, never duplicated
unconfirmed then adopted; one claim at payer
V-11: Signed payer webhooks refresh the claim; forged or malformed ones are refused
V-12: A query asking again for a document already sent (renamed) is detected
V-13: Query documents go to the insurer through the connector only after approval
approve card; payer query answered; stage back to submitted
V-14: The decision is compared line by line; deductions without a clause are flagged
V-15: Payment is verified only by a matching credit on the bank statement
payment_verified by UTR from the mock bank statement PDF
V-16: A short or missing bank credit is flagged
V-17: Cashless claim: no bank credit expected; the patient share is explained
V-18: Exact duplicate upload refused; a corrected file is versioned (replace or keep both)
V-19: Caregiver authority is checked against the uploaded proof
V-20: Withdrawn consent pauses work, cancels approval and blocks submission
approval cleared; submit refused; re-record restores
V-21: The payer refusing a representative is reported plainly
V-22: Household: the claimant chooses the policy; a balance claim goes to the second policy
choose_policy; balance pack claims only the balance
V-23: Grievance letter is approved by the user; filing date validated; 14-day reminder
approve_letter; future date refused; reminder raised
V-24: Ombudsman route is gated: too early refused, opened by the insurer's reply
V-25: A revised decision reopens only the decision and payment check; extra money is a top-up due
V-26: Instructions inside an insurer document never authorise an action
no approval, no submission, no state change beyond reading
V-27: Prompt injection in chat or a file name never approves or submits
no submission; any pack still needs the user's approval
V-28: Upload validation: wrong bytes, wrong type, oversize and bad thread ids
V-29: Buttons cannot be forged: not offered, wrong data or unknown ids are refused
V-30: Originals are served only from the same thread's current pack
404 across threads; 409 when the pack is not ready
V-31: Concurrent requests on one thread are serialised without errors or lost writes
V-32: Reminders that are no longer due are resolved, not left active
overdue reminder resolved after the decision
V-33: Manual submission: future or malformed dates refused; recorded date drives the 15-day clock
BAD_DATE reply; submitted stage with due date
V-34: Claim state survives a backend restart (Postgres checkpoints)
same stage and documents after restart
V-35: The thread list never exposes other people's claims
only the caller's own thread ids are returned
V-36: Gateway or payer outages never crash a turn
turn completes; connection or submission marked, not 500
V-37: Structured choices (claim type) are saved without relying on the model
saved by the button endpoint; refused after submission
